summary: Merge repeated enum declarations into same runtime object.

source.pattern: enum E { A=1 } ... enum E { B=2 }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: merged
tests.input: enum E { A=1 }; enum E { B=2 }; console.log(E.A,E.B);

tests.name: reverse merged
tests.input: enum E { A=1 }; enum E { B=2 }; console.log(E[1],E[2]);
